write_up: This is a strong security resume! Your move from monitoring client environments at Northgate Managed Security to detection and response at Capital Ridge Bank is easy to follow. The recent work shows both what you built and what changed, which gives a recruiter more than a list of security tools.

The Splunk detection-rules line is the model: it names the work, the framework and the reduction in false positives. Your incident response line is strong too, with a clear change in containment time. Experience is easy to find, and your certifications reinforce the work.

Let's add a little more about the purple-team exercises and alert enrichment, if you can. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own; the match with a particular role and how competitive it is will matter too.
